Method of Attack: Distributed via malspam pretending to be from the Internal Revenue Service
Malspam emails contain zip attachments with malicious Word documents
Victim must enable macros to download and execute ransomware
Ransomware encrypts data files appending .rapid extension
Creates autorun entry to persist and encrypt new files on login
Attack Vector: Malspam email with zip attachment containing malicious Word document
Indicators of Compromise: Email subjects like 'Please Note - IRS Urgent Message-164'
Malicious Word document requiring Enable Editing and Enable Content
